name: 浮球藏物罐
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. A salvaged orange marine float repurposed as a lidded storage vessel, rounded buoy body with flattened stable bottom, short dark cap closed, one rope loop and a cream repair patch. Round footprint diameter.55tile, height35px at tile144. No water, no base, no floating effects. Closed unsearched. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent, without a background tint/glow or ground. Localized hand-worn areas, uneven small repairs and stable readable silhouette; not systematically scratched everywhere.
